'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni Civil War]]
**Three [[Military of Yemen|Yemeni soldiers]] are killed and several others are injured by a [[Houthi]] [[drone attack]] on a convoy carrying [[politics of Yemen|government]] officials, including [[Yemen]]'s defense minister. [http://english.news.cn/20230325/9321bc20cfef4614af8998a5e20d0495/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Pokhran missile incident]]
**Three [[surface-to-air missile]]s are misfired by the [[Indian Army]] during an [[military exercise|exercise]] in the [[Pokhran#Pokhran_Nuclear_Test_Range|Pokhran]] ranges in the western [[Jaisalmer district]] of [[Rajasthan]], [[India]]. There are no reports of damage or casualties. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1744141/three-missiles-misfired-during-indian-army-exercise-in-rajasthan-report (Dawn)]
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 24–25, 2023]]
**A deadly tornado outbreak hits [[Mississippi]], [[United States]], killing at least 26 people, devastating several rural towns, and prompting [[Governor of Mississippi|Governor]] [[Tate Reeves]] to declare a [[state of emergency]], while [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] promises federal assistance. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-65075276 (BBC News)]
*Three people are killed by heavy snow and rainfall in [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-snowfall-heavy-rain-cf9c59cafa96968e489e1a292e3988ee (AP)]
*One person is killed and three others are injured in a [[train crash]] at [[Galați railway station]] in [[Romania]]. [https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/accident-feroviar-grav-in-gara-din-galati-patru-raniti-doi-in-stare-grava-2294755 (Digi24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**[[2022–2023 blockade of the Republic of Artsakh]]
***The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Ministry of Defence]] in [[Russia]] accuses [[Azerbaijan]] of violating the [[2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement|2020 ceasefire agreement]] after a unit of the [[Azerbaijani Armed Forces]] crosses the [[Line of Contact (Nagorno-Karabakh)|Line of Contact]] in [[Shushi Province]], [[Republic of Artsakh|Artsakh]], and seizes control of dirt roads near the [[Lachin corridor]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/asia-pacific/20230325-russia-accuses-azerbaijan-of-violating-ceasefire-agreement-with-armenia (France 24)]
*[[Russia and weapons of mass destruction]], [[Belarus–Russia relations]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] announces that Russia will station [[tactical nuclear weapon]]s in [[Belarus]] by July. The nuclear missiles will be operated by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]]. It will be the first time that Russian [[nuclear weapon]]s have been deployed abroad since 1996. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-65077687 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-says-moscow-has-deal-with-belarus-station-nuclear-weapons-there-tass-2023-03-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Yevgeny Prigozhin]], leader of the [[Wagner Group]], says that more than 5,000 prisoners have been [[pardon]]ed following the completion of their contracts in [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-pardons-5000-former-criminals-after-fighting-ukraine-prigozhin-says-2023-03-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in Venezuela]]
**Twenty-one [[Venezuelan government]] officials and businessmen are arrested in an anti-[[corruption]] probe targeting state oil company [[PDVSA]] and [[cryptocurrency]] regulator Sunacrip. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/venezuela-arrests-21-corruption-crackdown-11-more-wanted-2023-03-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 New South Wales state election]]
**[[New South Wales Labor Party|Labor]] is declared the winner after [[Chris Minns]] wins at least 47 seats. Premier [[Dominic Perrottet]] concedes defeat and [[resignation|resigns]] as [[New South Wales Liberal Party|Liberal]] leader. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/labor-party-takes-power-fresh-start-australias-biggest-state-2023-03-25/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-03-25/labor-set-to-win-nsw-election-sealing-australia-s-left-turn (Bloomberg)]
